summary.text: Mark Cohen of Lemoyne, Nebraska, is running on the Nonpartisan ballot line in the Nov. 3, 2026 general election for Nebraska's 3rd District. He describes himself as a father, veteran, agricultural lawyer, and karate instructor.

paragraphs.text: Cohen is a former Air Force judge advocate who first came to Nebraska more than forty years ago, according to Nebraska Rural Radio, and he has served as a Special Assistant U.S. Attorney for Nebraska.
He later practiced law in Omaha during the farm crisis of the late 1980s, according to Nebraska Rural Radio.
He says he has been a Nebraska Admiral for 39 years.
Cohen submitted about 3,680 signatures on July 30, 2026, to qualify for the ballot as a nonpartisan candidate; state law requires at least 2,000 valid signatures.
The Nebraska Examiner reported in August 2026 that he had been certified for the ballot.
